{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    # Sparse canvas with a fixed 2x2 marker and a larger polyomino, palette {0,2,8}.
    H=rng.randint(5,18); W=rng.randint(7,26)
    g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # marker is a compact square of a nonzero color
    s=rng.choice([2,2,2,3])
    mr=rng.randint(1,H-s-1); mc=rng.randint(1,W-s-1)
    for r in range(mr,mr+s):
        for c in range(mc,mc+s): g[r][c]=8
    # make a connected irregular object, placed to the right of marker
    cells={(0,0)}
    target=rng.randint(5,14)
    while len(cells)<target:
        r,c=rng.choice(tuple(cells)); dr,dc=rng.choice([(1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)])
        cells.add((r+dr,c+dc))
    minr=min(r for r,c in cells); minc=min(c for r,c in cells)
    cells={(r-minr,c-minc) for r,c in cells}
    ph=max(r for r,c in cells)+1; pw=max(c for r,c in cells)+1
    # preferentially put it on the right, with at least one-cell gap
    pr=rng.randint(0,max(0,H-ph-1))
    pc=rng.randint(min(W-pw-1,mc+s+1),max(min(W-pw-1,mc+s+1),0)) if W-pw-1>=0 else 0
    pc=min(max(0,pc),W-pw)
    for r,c in cells:
        if g[pr+r][pc+c]==0:g[pr+r][pc+c]=2
    return g"}
